title.narrative: Support to Ukraine¿s efforts in tackling disinformation

description.narrative: Contract related to: Support to Ukraine¿s efforts in tackling disinformation - This 18-month measure aims at promoting a consolidated responseto disinformation and reinforcing ceasefiremonitoringin Ukraine.A first component of the action will provide support for effective responses to disinformation to the Ukrainian Centre for Strategic Communications and Information Security, as well as facilitate partnerships with relevant counterparts in the EU, in line with the commitments agreed as part of the comprehensive EU-Ukraine Partnership. This will be done in compliance with international norms and best practices in this area, including facilitation of cooperation with civil society.A second component of the action was designed to enable the EU to continue and further enhance the provision of satellite imagery to the OSCE Special Monitoring Mission (SMM). This was crucial for in-depth analysis of the situation in areas where there was no access, or for more secure patrolling in areas where access is possible. The action, during its first phase allowed the Special Monitoring Mission to sustain and expand monitoring in a highly volatile environment, helping to ensure the safety of the mission¿s staff and enabling effective monitoring and objective documentation.Following the suspension of the OSCE SMM on 28 April 2022, satellite imagery will now be provided to the governments of Ukraine and Moldova for civilian purposes, for example relating to the safety of key infrastructure such as for electricity, oil, gas, and transport, or for the assessment of damages for the purpose of reconstruction.
